recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-11482 unless the Financial Management work group raises a new, specific change to the current module introduction.
issue_request: FHIR-11482 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core financial management change request from the 2016-09 ballot asking that the Financial module introduction at financial-module.html#intro be filled in properly.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-11482. The financial module page was introduced with placeholder introduction text in 062fc591e13dbbb9e9a0969f2935fc58624bf4d4, and commit 4d97b6212a43b9561b83b29f7d66794a58c22fbe replaced that placeholder with substantive introduction prose and neighboring module links immediately before the recorded 2016-12-02 vote. Later commits cleaned, refactored, and expanded the page without restoring the missing-introduction problem.
additional_context: The current financial-module.html page is in current build scope through source/hierarchy.xml and the module list. Its Introduction section describes the financial resources and services for costing, contracting, financial transactions, billing, eligibility, enrollment, authorizations, claims, contracts, payments, and reporting/notification between parties. Jira searches found only the seed tracker, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting or clarifying community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source has the requested introduction and no remaining placeholder text, so adding more prose would be optional editorial expansion rather than a required reconciliation fix.
